---
title: "Sprott P System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& ay+z\\
\dot{y} &=& -x+y^2\\
\dot{z} &=& x+y
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=2.7$ and initial condition $(1,1,-1)$.
